title: spec: ai.requiresConfirmation's describe says REST /actions reads no ai.exposed opt-in, which PR #32912 makes untrue for an AI service account starting a runAs:system flow action
body:
domain:server#8 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwqTK71kjQzHae8T5J

Blocked-by: #32912
Part of: follow-up of #31874 (ruling C, comment 6812617393)
Source: contract review of PR #32912, record 6839053991, should-fix S1 and S2.

## Problem

`packages/spec/src/ai/tool.zod.ts` (the `requiresConfirmation` `.describe()` string, around line 96, a published string) defines the confirmation gate's enforced set as "the doors that enforce the author's `ai.exposed` opt-in — today the action door reached from the MCP `run_action` tool", and says "REST `/actions` is NOT `ai.exposed`-gated". Once PR #32912 lands, the REST actions route DOES read the opt-in for one pair: an AI service account (an agent principal with no `onBehalfOf`) starting a `type: 'flow'` action whose flow declares `runAs: 'system'` is refused unless the action declares `ai.exposed: true`. The published sentence then gives a wrong reason for that pair.

## Do

1. Reword the describe string so it stays true after #32912: REST `/actions` asks `ai.exposed` only of an AI service account starting a `runAs: 'system'` flow action (ADR-0151 Non-goals sentence, `flowStartRefusal` rule 2), and the confirmation gate is still not enforced there. Regenerate whatever the describe string feeds (JSON schema / reference docs) in the same change.
2. Decision for the maintainer (S2), before or with item 1: the 403 from #32912 points the account at "the REST actions route or the MCP `run_action` tool" as equals, yet an author's `ai.requiresConfirmation: true` on the same action is asked only on MCP. Options: (A) keep it so (document the asymmetry in the describe string); (B) the REST route also asks `confirm: true` of an AI service account on an action declaring `ai.requiresConfirmation: true`. B widens the REST refusal set (BREAKING for that caller) and needs its own contract review. Not owed by ruling C.

## Acceptance

- The describe string names no door wrongly; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec` generated artefacts regenerated; prose-only unless the maintainer picks B.
- `Clause-②: no` for item 1 alone (describe text, no accept-set change).
